title: Surface network worker running-settings drift
summary: Implement A1 from the network worker hardening plan by exposing the running worker dispatcher settings and comparing them with saved network settings.
reason: A running worker can keep polling an old coordinator URL/token/path-map after settings change, and the operator needs visible read-only evidence before reconnecting.
behavior_before: The Network surface did not show when the live worker dispatcher used settings that differed from saved configuration.
behavior_after: The Network surface reports saved-vs-running worker drift without exposing full auth tokens.
manual_validation: PYTHONPATH=src apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe -m unittest discover -s tests/python/desktop -p test_network*.py -q -> 276 tests OK
rollback_plan: Revert the dispatcher descriptor, drift comparison, UI rendering, tests, and generated summaries for this packet.
